subject.title: feat(macos): redesign chat window as native shell with sessions sidebar, toolbar pickers, slash commands, and context usage

question: Should OpenClaw accept this broad native macOS chat-window redesign as the product direction after the session-state blocker, merge conflicts, and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The code review can identify concrete blockers, but the PR replaces a major native app surface and carries a protected maintainer label, so product acceptance should remain a maintainer choice.

options.title: Accept After Blockers
options.body: Keep this as the candidate implementation, but require selected-agent scoping, a clean merge, and attached live macOS proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Transport Fixes
options.body: Land only the session transport and command-catalog repairs while leaving the shell redesign for a separate UX iteration.

options.title: Pause The Redesign
options.body: Park or close this PR if maintainers do not want a broad native-shell replacement in this release window.

recommendation.title: Accept After Blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this as the candidate implementation, but require selected-agent scoping, a clean merge, and attached live macOS proof before merge.
